entities.summary: Levan Georgiyevich Sanadze was a Georgian sprinter. Domestically, he had represented the sports club Nauka Tbilisi and would win two titles in the men's 4 x 100 metres relay at the Soviet Championships alongside his teammates. He would compete at the 1951 World Festival of Youth and Students and 1954 World Student Games, winning two silvers in the 100 metres and two golds in the men's 4 x 100 metres relay.
